title: Product ad shots
summary: Plan a short vertical product ad: lock the product's look, prepare hero, detail and in-use shots with shot lines, and set up the reel edit.
author: Viral Hit contributors

inputs.label: Product
inputs.description: What the product is and what must look exactly right, such as label text, logo placement and colors.

inputs.label: Product images
inputs.description: Project images or absolute local paths; one clear front view.

inputs.label: Approved claims
inputs.description: Claims or copy the user has approved for the ad.

stages.title: Lock the product
stages.description: Define the product as a character with exact label, logo and color rules.

stages.title: Plan three shots
stages.description: Propose hero, detail and in-use drafts with shot lines and write them to Canvas after approval.

stages.title: Set up the edit
stages.description: Offer the Short-form reel kit for the cut; running and generation are separate requests.
